author: Creator Saga
title: Looking for Leonardo da Vinci style artist for TRPCG
content:
Looking for an artist for an ongoing commission on my TRPCG Creator Saga.

I’m specifically seeking someone whose work is in a Leonardo da Vinci draftsmanship style — precise line work, anatomical accuracy, scientific sketch quality, Renaissance-era hatching and shading, and that characteristic exploratory, notebook-style approach.
Please only apply if your portfolio clearly shows this style (or a very close equivalent). If your work is primarily modern digital illustration, anime, cartoony, or any other style, this is not the right fit.

If this matches your strengths, or someone you know, feel free to share relevant examples of your work.

Thank you.
